item.title: Some good bad advice
item.description: Between watching the new Spider-Noir and upsetting myself with the June 7th election drama in my country, I opted for a third option: writing this article. Truth be told, looking at the political landscape back home, it’s hard not to get some popcorn, shut off your brain, put on the hat of a football fan, and watch some fruitless debates. I almost regret not capitalizing on those heavily subsidized diaspora flights just to go back and vote; there really is nothing quite like the irony of people deciding the fate of a country without having to bear any of the daily consequences.
